title: Small for 2 or 3 people, light weight, Is this pan BPA Free? long user friendly handle.
text:
Small for 2 or 3 people, light weight, Is this pan BPA Free? long user friendly handle.. Don’t be fooled for thinking this is 11 inch. Only 11 inches at the top. This is a small Wok for two, maybe 3 people.

Very light weight , which I’m starting to like as I get older. The handle is user friendly, long, and comfortable.
When using a light weight pan they heat up fast, so do not use a high flame with this pan, and stay close cause you need to move your food around.

I like this pan besides using it for a Wok.
The bottom is small, but I like the high sides for sautéing veggies, and putting a egg or two on top.
Or using avocado oil to sauté one or two chicken breasts , the oil stays on the inside of the pan. etc.

This is a pan I would see in Walmart, or Target, not in a high end cookware store.
I notice the price of this pan keeps going down on Amazon!

It says it is PFOE free, which is good, but there are other toxins in cookware besides that one!
I have asked a question 3 times, and my question was taken off!!
My question is , Is this Pan BPA Free?
